request.description:
TestTheEvacuationWaitsOutTheSupervisorsPushThatHoldsTheRefLock (internal/reconcile/evacuate_test.go, added by fn8) fails on EVERY CI run of epic/t8u since fn8 merged: 15 consecutive red runs, head 9b03556be included (run 37716696321, job 'go test (reconcile 2/3)').

What goes wrong on git >= 2.51:
- receive-pack uses batched reference updates, so a push whose ref lock is refused STILL runs the reference-transaction hook in state 'prepared', with the refused ref on stdin.
- The test's hook holds ANY prepared transaction naming the attempt branch until fn8-go appears. So it holds the flush's own push too.
- fn8-go is written only when a THIRD push arrives. That cannot happen while the second push is held, so the flush's first push burns the whole budget.
- That matches the account on CI: 'did not finish inside its bound: context deadline exceeded', and 'only 2 pushes'.

Platform difference:
- Apple git 2.50.1 refuses the second push before the hook runs, so the test passes locally and the gate passes. CI has git 2.55.
- Reproduced deterministically in alpine:edge (git 2.56, go 1.27): the same three assertion failures.
- A shell repro (two pushes, one held at 'prepared') shows git 2.56 running the second push's hook with the refused ref, while git 2.50 does not.

Fix, verified in that container:
- Hold only the FIRST prepared transaction. Insert `mkdir <held>.once 2>/dev/null || exit 0` before `echo held` in the hook, and add one Sprintf argument.
- With it, the test passes in 1.3s on git 2.56.
- With fn8's production fix reverted (one read of origin), it still FAILS with all three assertions, so the guard keeps discriminating.

Production code is unaffected: without a hook, the refused push fails fast and evacuateBranch's loop re-reads origin. The close-out cannot be readied while epic CI is red.
evidence: internal/reconcile/evacuate_test.go:256-275 (the reference-transaction hook); CI run 37716696321 job 'go test (reconcile 2/3)': evacuate_test.go:336/342/349

ticfac run epic-t8u filed this backlog tick from the finding 679fb516c93ea7a9b963ce3bf516dbffb12a730e96f9b8baa61e88433361d481 (reported by run-epic-t8u/tick-r6v/attempt-18) rather than absorb it into the running epic: its reporter rated it high severity and named the done it breaks, but the epic's work was done when it was reported, so it is deferred to the final reviewer. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-t8u/absorptions/679fb516c93ea7a9b963ce3bf516dbffb12a730e96f9b8baa61e88433361d481.json on the run branch.
request.title: fn8's ref-lock guard deadlocks on git >= 2.51; epic CI red since 9a34b1001
